use_case_name: Transfer a Winning Order to Another Customer

claims.content: If matches are found between the transfer recipient and the winner on Customer Name, Customer Phone Number, Customer Email Address, Customer Member ID, or Customer Billing and/or Shipping Addresses, the 2nd-Chance email (transfer offer) is not sent.
If the 2nd-place finisher's bid is below the item's unit cost, the 2nd-Chance email (transfer offer) is not sent.

The 2nd-Chance email will not be sent to recipients who have two accounts and are essentially bidding against themselves. The system compares the 2nd-Chance recipient's account data to the Winner's account data; if matches are found on Customer Name, Customer Phone Number, Customer Email Address, Customer Member ID, or Customer Billing and/or Shipping Addresses, the email is not sent.
